display.purpose: Index row names only — the page's whole message at poster scale.

ghost.purpose: Outline-only ornament (1px red stroke, 14% alpha); never carries information.

body.purpose: Intro prose; one voice, smaller size.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: load reads top to bottom (intro, rows, status). Ghost fades only. Reduced motion: opacity-only 200ms, no stagger.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on index rows; the band itself never moves.

motion.name: blink-block
motion.purpose: Block cursor blink; the only looping motion. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-flip
motion.purpose: Background/color inversion on hover and focus (color changes read best on ease, not ease-out). Hover gated to (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

components.name: Index Row
components.description: The signature component: full-bleed poster row — numeral chip, giant name, suffix metadata. Inverts to a red band on hover/focus. Arrow keys cycle the standing inversion across rows infinitely (real focus follows, Enter opens natively).
components.html: 01hello-cube3d · view3d · beta
components.css: .ds-index-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 36px; padding: 26px 48px; background: transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-index-row:hover, .ds-index-row:focus-visible { background: #e5483c; outline: none; } .ds-num { flex-shrink: 0; width: 84px; height: 84px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #e5483c; color: #0b0908; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-index-row:hover .ds-num, .ds-index-row:focus-visible .ds-num { background: #0b0908; color: #ff5f4d; } .ds-name { font-size: clamp(44px, 7.5vw, 92px); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1; color: #d8cfc7; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-index-row:hover .ds-name, .ds-index-row:focus-visible .ds-name { color: #0b0908; } .ds-suffix { font-size: 16px; color: #8a7e76; margin-left: 8px; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-index-row:hover .ds-suffix, .ds-index-row:focus-visible .ds-suffix { color: rgba(11,9,8,0.92); }

components.name: Numeral Chip
components.description: Solid red square carrying the lab number; inverts on the row's active state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 84px; height: 84px; background: #e5483c; color: #0b0908; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Status Line
components.description: Pinned bottom edge: lab count, beta status, open hint, github, blinking cursor.
components.html: labs: 2 · status: beta↵ opengithub ↗
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; gap: 3ch; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid #2a1f1a; padding: 14px 48px 18px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #8a7e76; } .ds-sp { flex: 1; } .ds-gh { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-gh:hover { color: #ff5f4d; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Mono wordmark with the '3d' syllable in Signal Red; links home.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #d8cfc7; text-decoration: none; } .ds-d3 { color: #e5483c; }

components.name: Ghost Watermark
components.description: Outline-only giant numeral/word: Signal Red stroke over the ground, ink where a red band crosses it (mix-blend difference) — a print-style negative. Ornament; aria-hidden, never informative.
components.css: .ds-ghost { position: fixed; right: -0.05em; top: 90px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: clamp(180px, 30vw, 400px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.05em; color: transparent; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #e5483c; mix-blend-mode: difference; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; z-index: 2; }

components.name: Link (discreet)
components.description: Dim warm-gray text link with a red hover end — used for github and inline hints.
components.css: .ds-link { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #8a7e76; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-link:hover { color: #ff5f4d; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px dashed #e5483c; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: The interface is the poster: two lines of poster-scale monospace type carry the whole page, and everything else — a wordmark, one intro line, a pinned status line, a ghost outline numeral — exists to frame them. The mood is warm machine nostalgia: a near-black warm ground with Signal Red doing the talking. Nothing here is skeuomorphic chrome; the TUI world arrives as material (mono at scale, phosphor red, blinking block cursors, hairline rules), never as a replica of a terminal window. Depth does not exist in this system and that is a choice: surfaces answer through full-bleed color inversion, not elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Poster-scale mono type as the only layout device — no cards, no panels, no boxes
Full-bleed inverse-video bands as the interaction grammar
One face, one red, one ground; hairlines are the only structure
Warm nostalgia expressed through color and the blinking cursor, not through fake textures

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Red is the voice of state: it fills a whole band when the interface answers you and stays out of the content's way at rest. Cream and Warm Gray carry reading; red carries action.

rules.name: The Warm Black Rule
rules.body: The ground is #0b0908 — warm and never pure #000; text on it is never pure #fff.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is the only face, self-hosted; no second typeface enters the system.

rules.name: The Flat Phosphor Rule
rules.body: No box-shadows, no gradients-as-depth. An element is either on the ground, in a red band, or outlined.

dos: Do set index content as poster-scale rows (clamp(44px, 7.5vw, 92px), 700, −0.035em) with red numeral chips.
Do express every interactive answer as the full-bleed inverse band, hover and focus included.
Do bind middots in narrow suffix metadata (token\u00A0·) so lines never open with a separator.
Do keep the ground #0b0908 and text ≥4.5:1 against it (suffix ink over red at 0.92 alpha minimum).
Do self-host the JetBrains Mono variable woff2 (/fonts/jetbrains-mono-var.woff2).
Do gate :hover motion behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine); :active press feedback is ungated (a press is real on touch).
donts: Don't use ASCII/box-drawing art where it carries meaning — it rendered broken in real browsers; graphics are CSS solids or nothing.
Don't add shadows, gradients-as-depth, or border-radius; the system is flat and square.
Don't introduce a second typeface or an icon set; type and red squares are the vocabulary.
Don't soften or remove the standing inversion of the last index row — it is the page's memorable moment.
Don't let red drift to another hue: Signal Red (#e5483c) and its bright end (#ff5f4d) are the only reds.
